task_description: Spec-driven, assumption-free re-audit of the full LiteCowork documentation corpus, a fresh competitor deep-dive, and a superset matrix with three-way gap analysis. Phase 1: verify every doc claim against code reality and produce a doc-claim -> code-reality -> verdict (true/stale/aspirational-unlabeled/contradicted) table, file newly-discovered contradictions into docs/CONTRADICTION-AND-ALIGNMENT-REGISTER.md with proper A-xx/B-xx IDs, reconcile known drift (line counts, sqlite-v28/A-40, FLOWS index/A-38, UIV1 namespace/A-39) and surface SDD-completeness gaps. Phase 2: re-verify existing rivals with fresh dates/SHAs, resolve every user-named rival (Claude Code desktop, OpenWork, Open Cowork, ZCode desktop=zai-org/ZCode, DeepSeek Harness=deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, OpenAI dots, Muse assistant, OpenBot=nightly-labs/openbot, Grok bot, etc.), find NEW rivals, and record runtimes/HLD/LLD + exact borrowable-file URLs with license notes, updating the five existing competitor owner docs in place. Phase 3: author a superset feature x {LiteCowork done? / doc-claims? / doc-accuracy / each competitor has it?} matrix plus the three lists (Done/Not-done, doc errors, missing-to-be-superset), cross-linked from the viability/competitive docs. All work obeys the repo authority model and evidence vocabulary; deliverable is durable repo doc changes on a feature branch (coder cannot push; orchestrator publishes).
